hypothesis_title: Iter 27 — Multi-Regime Adaptive Optimizer (위기 특화 배분 초고도화)
hypothesis_description:
Iter 27 — 사용자 mandate 정수: 비중결정 방법론 초고도화 + 위기 국면 위기 특화 배분.

## 동기 (사용자 mandate + 12 sprint 학습)
- 사용자 새 mandate: 비중결정 방법론 초고도화 + 위기 특화 배분
- Iter 11 baseline: LinTilt λ=1.0 + 4-state cash (BULL=0/NORMAL=5/CAUTION=15/CRISIS=30)
- 본 sprint = baseline 모든 차원 (method + λ + cash + max_w + sleeve) regime adaptive 초고도화

## 핵심 가설 — 4-State Adaptive Optimizer

### State 1: BULL
- Method: LinTilt aggressive λ=1.5
- Cash: 0%
- Max_w: 0.20
- Hedge sleeve: 0%
- Alpha tilt 강하게 (alpha activation 우선)

### State 2: NORMAL
- Method: LinTilt baseline λ=1.0 (Iter 11)
- Cash: 5%
- Max_w: 0.20
- Hedge sleeve: 5%
- Iter 11 baseline preserved

### State 3: CAUTION
- Method: ERC + EW shrink (대안: 50% LinTilt + 50% ERC)
- Cash: 20%
- Max_w: 0.15 (자동 shrink)
- Hedge sleeve: 15%
- Risk control 강화

### State 4: CRISIS (위기 특화)
- Method: **Risk Parity + Hedge dominant**
- Cash: **50%**
- Max_w: **0.10** (강한 shrink)
- Hedge sleeve: **30%** (V22b/V25 active)
- Alpha 비중 down, 분산/hedge 비중 up

## Sleeve Composition (위기 특화)
- Core sleeve: STR_1701 (Iter 11 baseline)
- Hedge sleeve: V22b coskew/anti-corr (Iter 22b/25 inheritance) — CRISIS 시 활성화
- Defense ML: STR_1656 (PG2 inheritance, 평시도 유지)

## 12 sprint 학습 BLOCKING (모두 회피)
- L-211/225/228: cross-section linear/sigmoid/ML 회피 — 본 sprint는 Optimizer-side (alpha base 그대로)
- L-220: monthly base (NOT quarterly machinery)
- L-226: ERC near-EW alpha activation 부재 — CAUTION/CRISIS만 ERC, BULL/NORMAL은 LinTilt
- L-229: Optimizer mechanism alone insufficient — 본 sprint는 multi-regime + multi-sleeve
- L-230: Time dimension cost-negative
- L-231 continuous overlay fail — discrete 4-state (Iter 11 inheritance)
- L-232/233 long-only defensive overlay realized inversion — Hedge sleeve는 V22b/V25 inheritance + CRISIS only

## 핵심 mandate
- alpha base: STR_1701 그대로 (cor ≥ 0.95)
- Optimizer **초고도화**: 4-state adaptive method + sleeve allocation
- AX-001 v2 4-metric strict (위기 특화 배분 → bad/normal IC ratio + crisis_alpha + MDD relief)
- Universe: KR_top342 (현재) + KR_TOP500 옵션 (Iter 19 결과)

## 평가
- BULL 평시 SR ≥ Iter 11 (alpha tilt aggressive로 향상 expected)
- CRISIS 위기 MDD relief ≥ 10pp (vs Iter 11 baseline)
- Realized PG2 blend SR > 1.4625 + crisis MDD 본질적 완화
- AX-001 v2 4/4 strict
